steps.content: At the entrance of a shop, a middle-aged man is tearing off the notice on the door.

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: Hey! I remember you! The fella who came to buy water and get change in the middle of the night!
steps.female_content: Hey! I remember you! The girl who came to buy water and get change in the middle of the night!

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: What's up? Need some change again?
Ah, no, I just... I saw you tearing the notice off and I was wondering, have all these people come back?

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: Yes, and these have been up for too long. Look, the words on them are all smudged. Even if they haven't been found, I need to replace them.
The shopkeeper shakes the torn notice at you. You look at the words and find that all information related to Call at 3 AM is now illegible, as if it's been soaked in water.
Indeed... Um, do you remember why they disappeared? I can't read anything on this.

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: Hmm... I really don't remember... They all look pretty young. I hope they weren't sold as Hypercube miners to the private mines.
You help the shopkeeper remove all the notices, for which he insists on giving you a piece of candy. Unable to refuse, you follow him into the grocery store to get one.

There's a trace of Mania scent in the shop, so faint that it can only indicate that someone has activated their Mania ability here before. But no one was hurt here and no property was damaged. Only the memories related to Call at 3 AM have been completely erased.
